id: title:EDsCODE:gate ducklake registration on a provisioned duckgres server

observations.behavior: Adds a guard that checks DuckgresServer provisioning before allowing the workflow to proceed; returns early without attempting downstream control-plane calls.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces unnecessary external dependency and potential transient failures for teams whose feature flag is enabled but lack provisioned warehouse infrastructure.

observations.code_quote: logger.info("DuckLake data imports registration gated off (flag disabled or no DuckgresServer)")
observations.behavior: Updates logging message to reflect both gating conditions rather than only the flag state.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies operational diagnostics when registration fails due to missing provisioning, aiding support and debugging.

observations.code_quote: lambda team_id: MagicMock() if server_provisioned else None,
observations.behavior: Adds parameterized tests asserting correct behavior with and without a provisioned DuckgresServer. Tests are not complete end-to-end integration, but do cover the new gate path.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against future changes removing this provisioning check.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H2 demonstrates substantive change; other hunks are minor updates or test additions. No broader systemic risk reduction shown across multiple components.

review.limitations: Only P1.F1.H2 demonstrates substantive change; other hunks are minor updates or test additions. No broader systemic risk reduction shown across multiple components.
review.reason: The added provisioning-dependent gate in H2 represents a bounded correctness improvement that could prevent spurious failures while preserving intended functionality. The accompanying log update and targeted unit tests support this, though they do not establish wider architectural benefit.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's managed warehouse ingestion reliability by avoiding unnecessary control-plane calls for unprovisioned orgs.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on understanding of Duckgres provisioning semantics from comments; no live metrics or production incident context available.
